voiceover: Five thousand dollars on a credit card at twenty-two percent. You pay a hundred dollars a month. How long until it's gone? Eleven and a half years. And you pay about eight thousand seven hundred dollars in interest. More than the debt itself. Now pay two hundred fifty a month instead. Gone in about two years, and interest drops to roughly thirteen hundred. The extra hundred fifty a month saves you over seven thousand dollars. The payment size is the whole game. Comment CASH for the free calculator and run your own card.
